data.title: About the link tool.
items: Yes. Building the draft is free. Catch takes 5% only when you sell tickets, never more than ₹10,000 a month.
Not yet. A person on our team builds each draft, which is why it takes up to [a working day].
Will it go live without me?
No. The draft is only visible to you until you claim it and publish it.
Can my guest list come too?
Yes. Send a CSV or Excel export and we’ll import it, or import it yourself in Catch Host.
What if my event is next week?
Send it now. Most drafts come back the same day.
